The Situation Room then initiated a video review to further examine the play and determined that the puck deflected off Rossi's shoulder and entered the Edmonton net in a legal fashion." Not a challengeable play; league-initiated under Rule 37.

market_impact.reason: Goal total unaffected: the number of goals is identical in both records; only credit or timing moved. Player-prop exposure: anytime-scorer / points / assist markets turn on who is credited, not on how many goals were scored. NHL box scores are not a sportsbook source of record. This is an exposure flag for review, not a claim that any market was mis-settled.

The game itself ended 2-2 (OT, no further goals), so the discrepancy is attribution-only and cannot move a goal total.
